title: Apply approved provider freshness policy to every launch path
description: Normal fleet up applies managed provider updates; audit hierarchy activation/start and persistent schedule wakes, interrupted-update recovery, concurrency and Windows npm execution. Apply policy consistently without introducing provider starts during install/preview or defeating existing wake locks and budgets.
acceptanceCriteria: All runtime launch paths honor the approved update policy or fail closed
Interrupted updates retain previous usable binaries and do not bypass wake reservations
Windows execution is qualified or clearly reported unsupported
